title: Weak subsequential compactness of bounded measures on one closed ball, with the closed-set portmanteau inequality
statement: Let P, R ∈ ℕ and let μ_j (j ∈ ℕ) be measures on ℝ^P = Eucl P with sup_j μ_j(ℝ^P) < ∞. Then there are a strictly increasing χ : ℕ → ℕ and a measure ν on ℝ^P with ν(ℝ^P) < ∞ such that every closed set F ⊆ ℝ^P with F ⊆ B̄_R(0) = closedBall 0 R satisfies limsup_{i→∞} μ_{χ(i)}(F) ≤ ν(F).
lean_statement: ∀ (P R : ℕ) (μ : ℕ → Measure (Eucl P)), (⨆ j, μ j univ) < ∞ → ∃ (χ : ℕ → ℕ) (ν : Measure (Eucl P)), StrictMono χ ∧ ν univ < ∞ ∧ ∀ F : Set (Eucl P), IsClosed F → F ⊆ closedBall 0 (R : ℝ) → limsup (fun i => μ (χ i) F) atTop ≤ ν F
